tasks.label: Android: stop Gradle daemons
tasks.detail: Frees the memory the Gradle daemon holds (Kotlin compiles inside it, so there is no Kotlin daemon)
tasks.command: if pgrep -f 'GradleDaemon' >/dev/null; then JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 17) ./gradlew --stop -q; sleep 2; if pgrep -f 'GradleDaemon' >/dev/null; then echo 'A Gradle daemon is still running (another Gradle version or project?)'; exit 1; else echo 'Stopped the Gradle daemon'; fi; else echo 'Nothing to stop: no Gradle daemon was running'; fi

tasks.label: Parity: compare iOS and Android payloads
tasks.detail: Needs sfere-ios-sdk and sfere-android-sdk side by side. Checks the shared files match, runs the parity scenario on both SDKs and diffs the upload bodies
